name: learning-agent
description: Judges whether an operator's edit to an AI draft reveals a genuine knowledge base gap, and if so drafts a new KB article capturing the correction. Read-only; a deterministic function persists the suggestion.

has_gap.description: True only if the correction reveals a genuine, reusable documentation gap.

title.description: Short, specific KB article title. Required if has_gap is true.

content.description: Standalone KB article body grounded in the operator's final_response. Required if has_gap is true.

category.description: Best-matching KB category. Required if has_gap is true.

reason.description: One sentence on what was missing or wrong, or why this isn't a gap.
